title: The Weird #4 DC Comics July 1988 Jim Starlin Berni Wrightson Batman Finale
condition_description: Light handling and edge wear, light toning. See photos.
description:
The Weird #4 (of 4) (DC Comics, July 1988), "The Explosive Finale!" Written by Jim Starlin, art and cover by Berni Wrightson, inks by Dan Green. Batman and the Justice League appear in silhouette on the cover. $1.50 cover price.

Back cover: TSR Forgotten Realms Black Wizards ad.

Condition: light handling and edge wear with light toning (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
